title: Direction to Pay: Repair Payments Assigned to the Repair Facility
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), an assigned repair payment is the repair payment the named insured directs to the repair facility on a claim of the coverage.

### Scope

- For a repair payment the named insured directs to the repair facility, and only for such a payment, the payment is figured under the company's rule for assigned repair payments. Every other repair payment remains the latest cumulative repair estimate less the deductible less the repair payments already made on the claim.
- For such a payment, and only for it, the deductible it carries is the one that rule sets, applied once per claim. The vehicle value paid to a loss payee on a total loss carries the deductible its own rule sets. Every other payment carries the package's collision deductible for a collision cause and its comprehensive deductible for any comprehensive cause, applied once per claim.
- A glass repair (glass mended rather than replaced) is never paid as an assigned repair payment. On a glass loss, an assigned repair payment pays a replacement.

### The direction-to-pay tool: `assign_repair_payment_77b6ee43`

**Situation of use and capability.** The named insured signs a direction to pay on their own physical damage claim, so that the repair payment for one estimate of the claim is issued straight to the repair facility. One run books one repair payment on the claim, made out to the repair facility and dated today. It records the deductible withheld from the payment and the estimate the payment pays, and adds the payment to the net claim payments of the vehicle coverage. The insured sees the payment confirmation, and the facility receives the funds.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `assign_repair_payment_77b6ee43` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to sign the direction.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `physdam_coverage_id` | The coverage id: the record identifier of the vehicle's comprehensive and collision coverage that the claim belongs to, as shown on the coverage record | Text identifier |
| `claim_number` | The claim number the payment belongs to, exactly as it appears on the claim's file entries | CLM- followed by 9 digits |
| `estimate_sequence` | The sequence number of the estimate or supplement this payment pays, as recorded on that estimate entry | Whole number, 1 or more |
| `amount` | The repair payment issued to the repair facility | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `deductible_applied` | The deductible withheld from this payment | US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent; 0.00 when none is withheld |

No parameter takes a fixed list of values.

**Return.** A one-line confirmation beginning "Repair payment issued" means the payment was booked. It names:
- the new payment reference (a text id);
- the claim number;
- the estimate sequence paid;
- the amount issued to the repair facility, in USD with 2 decimals;
- the deductible withheld, in USD with 2 decimals;
- the payment date (YYYY-MM-DD);
- the coverage's net claim payments after the payment, in USD with 2 decimals.

### Effect on the records

After a run, the claim's payment ledger carries a repair payment made out to the repair facility, recording the estimate sequence it pays and the deductible withheld. The coverage's net claim payments rise by the amount issued.
